faq.q1: How do I publish a listing?
faq.a1: Sign up, fill in your listing through a short wizard, and choose a package. Once an admin approves it, your listing becomes visible to guests.
faq.a2: No. Rentaj never takes a cut of your bookings — we only earn from the owner's monthly or yearly subscription. All booking money goes straight to you.
faq.q3: Can I connect my existing calendar?
faq.a3: Yes, iCal sync (import and export) is available, so you avoid double bookings if you already list elsewhere.
faq.a4: Anyone renting out real estate, event spaces, playrooms, vehicles, machinery, or equipment.
faq.q5: What kinds of bookings can I use?
faq.a5: Direct bookings, per-stay or per-slot bookings, with or without a built-in booking system — whatever fits your needs.
faq.q6: Can guests message me before booking?
faq.a6: Yes, the built-in messaging system lets guests reach you directly on the platform, before and after booking.
